author: dragon_trappers_lodge
title: Hiring Concept Artist for Miniatures
content: WE'RE HIRING: CONCEPT ARTIST! ⚔️ The position will entail creating 2d concept art for 3d printable fantasy miniatures. Concepts will need to be refined line art drawings. No rendering, color, or value work required. Typically no turnarounds required, occasional weapon or prop details may be needed. Often there will be multiple poses which will require loose sketches. 👉We pay $100/concept with more complex detailed creatures granting more pay on a case by case basis. If you enjoy designing characters and monsters but don't like spending weeks on the same design then this is for you. You will be able to work on many designs and someone who works quick will thrive in this role. The quicker you work the more we can send you. Creativity is extremely valuable and there is lots of room for creative freedom. People who don't work quickly, or are unable to take direction and revisions won't do well in this position. The following skill sets are required. ✔️in depth understanding of human anatomy ✔️in depth understanding of creature and animal anatomy ✔️great drawing and sketching skills ✔️understanding of dynamic posing ⚠️ IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ: All applications must be submitted through our official BambooHR hiring page, linked in our bio. We do not accept applications, review portfolios, answer hiring questions, or conduct any part of the recruitment process through Instagram, including DMs and comments. Please review the full job description and follow the application instructions provided there. Good luck!

author: dalluyonstudio
title: Looking for Graphic Artist (Freelance)
content: WE ARE LOOKING FOR GRAPHIC ARTIST AND VIDEO EDITOR! Job Title: Graphic Artist (Freelance) The Role: You will work closely with our social media manager. We are not only looking for someone with a sharp eye for design but also someone meticulous with text placement (such as CTA) and image compositions that convert viewers into followers, players, wishlisters, etc. Moreover, we need someone who is proactive with design suggestions and reflects brand elements surrounding Philippine culture & tradition incorporated into our games. Key Responsibilities: - Create game content poster layouts and graphic images for social media use. Use digital illustration, photo editing software, and layout software to create designs. - Collaborate with the social media team and production team to develop creative solutions. - Follow brand guidelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and revision feedback efficiently. Job Title: Video Editor (Freelance) The Role: You will work closely with our social media manager. We are not only looking for a visual, creative video editor but someone who knows how to hook doomscrollers on social media. Someone who knows how to arrange effective hooks, sound effects, and video transitions. And capable of crafting both short-form reels and long-form videos. Key Responsibilities: - Ability to create short-form reels and understand different types of hooks: text, visual, and transition hooks that grab people's attention in 3 seconds. - Edit a combination of raw video, photos, and audio into long-form formats. Add strong opening hooks, dynamic captions, sound effects (SFX), background music, and motion graphics. Raw video, photos, and audio are provided, but sometimes research is needed for royalty-free images, videos, and audio. - Perform basic color grading, audio cleanup, and visual formatting for different platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube, or 9:16 / 16:9 aspect ratios). - Follow brand guidelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and revision feedback efficiently. - Meet daily/weekly production and turnaround targets. Check our Facebook post: https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1ECvYzTQPm/ #DalluyonStudio #Batikan #Hiring
